name: Exa AI
tagline: Exa (formerly Metaphor) is a semantic search engine built for AI applications. Unlike keyword search, Exa understands meaning and intent, returning highly relevant web pages, papers, and documents. Developers use its API to add web retrieval to AI agents, research tools, and RAG pipelines.
